Name: staged_trend_features_structural_rules
Description: Reference structural/null/range checks for staged trend_features.
Ruleset:
Rules = [
  RowCount > 0,
  IsComplete "StockItemID",
  IsComplete "as_of_week_end_date",
  IsComplete "weeks_since_launch",
  IsComplete "units_sold_week",
  IsComplete "sales_amount_week",
  ColumnValues "weeks_since_launch" between 0 and 7,
  ColumnValues "units_sold_week" >= 0,
  ColumnValues "sales_amount_week" >= 0,
  ColumnValues "profit_week" between -1000000 and 1000000,
  ColumnValues "is_trending_8wk" in [0, 1, NULL]
]
